businessProfiles.summary: Independent specialty coffee roastery pioneering micro-lot Johor Liberica and ethical single-origin beans, roasted fresh in small batches in Bangsar.

products.name: KopiCraft Signature Johor Liberica (250g)
products.description: Rare micro-lot Liberica from Kulai, Johor. Distinct floral jasmine aroma with sweet jackfruit and dark cocoa finish.
features: Roasted weekly in small 12kg drum batches
benefits: Naturally low acidity cup that is gentle on sensitive stomachs
Celebrates authentic Malaysian heritage coffee with third-wave craftsmanship
Direct trade ensures ethical farmer wages (+25% above fair trade benchmark)
differentiators: First specialty roaster to earn SCA cupping score 85+ for Malaysian Liberica
Guaranteed roast date stamped on every valve bag

products.name: Barista Nitro-Steeped Cold Brew (500ml)
products.description: 18-hour cold drip extraction using Sumatra Gayo and Johor Liberica. Silky, chocolatey, zero bitter bite.
benefits: Instant cafe-quality iced latte at your office desk
differentiators: Filtered with quadruple micro-mesh to eliminate all sediment and bitterness

products.name: Artisan Ceramic Pour-Over Dripper Set
products.description: Locally handcrafted ceramic dripper with 12 interior spiral ribs designed for optimal extraction flow rate.
benefits: Retains brew heat 30% longer than plastic drippers
differentiators: Collaborative design with homegrown ceramic atelier in Petaling Jaya

productUSPs.title: Direct Johor Farmer Micro-Lot Partnership
productUSPs.description: We work directly with 12 multi-generation smallholder farming families in Kulai, Johor.
productUSPs.proofPoint: Direct trade contract certificates and batch QR code linking directly to farm coordinates.

productUSPs.title: Freshness Guaranteed: 48-Hour Roast-to-Pouch
productUSPs.description: Every order is packed and dispatched within 48 hours of being roasted.
productUSPs.proofPoint: Roast date handwritten and heat-embossed on each package.

productUSPs.title: 18-Hour Nitrogen Cold Steep Process
productUSPs.description: Slow-steeped under nitrogen blanket to preserve delicate volatile aromas without oxidation.
productUSPs.proofPoint: Lab-tested zero oxidation and shelf-life of 28 days refrigerated without additives.

audiencePersonas.name: Urban Coffee Explorer (Afiq & Chloe)
painPoints: Tired of burnt, bitter commercial chain coffee
Wants to support genuine Malaysian craft but finds specialty beans intimidating
Values aesthetic packaging and transparent sourcing
motivations: Weekend café hopping & home brewing ritual

audiencePersonas.name: Busy WFH Professional / Office Team Lead (Mei Ling)
painPoints: Needs quick high-grade coffee between back-to-back Zoom meetings
Frustrated by mediocre instant coffee pods and mess of grounds during busy workdays
motivations: Convenience without compromising premium artisan taste

brandVoices.tone: Warm, passionate, knowledgeable, approachable, proud Malaysian heritage (Bukan snob kopi!)

knowledgeFacts.claim: All KopiCraft beans are sourced directly from Kulai, Johor with +25% premium paid above fair-trade benchmark.
Roasting takes place every Tuesday and Friday in our Bangsar roastery using a cast-iron drum roaster.
Johor Liberica variety naturally has lower titratable acidity than standard Robusta and Arabica varieties.
Upcoming subscription service planned to launch at 15% discount in Q1 2027.
